## What's Changed
* dist: Migrate from Zulu Discovery API to Azul Metadata API by @jameswald in https://github.com/actions/setup-java/pull/1010
* feat: add .mvn/extensions.xml to Maven cache key pattern by @brunoborges with @Copilot in https://github.com/actions/setup-java/pull/1041
* Migrate to ESM and upgrade dependencies by @priyagupta108 in https://github.com/actions/setup-java/pull/1078
* Map Zulu x86 architecture to i686 for Azul Metadata API by @brunoborges in https://github.com/actions/setup-java/pull/1079
* Rename jdkFile input to jdk-file with deprecated alias by @brunoborges in https://github.com/actions/setup-java/pull/1083
* Infer distribution from asdf .tool-versions vendor prefix by @brunoborges in https://github.com/actions/setup-java/pull/1084

* feat: expose cache-primary-key output (#597) by @brunoborges in https://github.com/actions/setup-java/pull/1088
